# Vortix Kitchen

Foshan Vortix Co., LTD (brand name: Vortix Kitchen) is a professional manufacturer of induction cookers and infrared ceramic cookers, based in Foshan, Guangdong, China. The company has supplied 100+ global brands since 2010 and provides OEM/ODM private-label service for importers, distributors, and wholesalers worldwide.

## Products
- Induction cookers (single and double burner), power range 1800W to 5000W
- Infrared ceramic cookers (compatible with all cookware types)
- Ultra-slim portable induction cookers
- Heavy-duty commercial-grade induction cookers for restaurants and catering

## Manufacturing & Service Capabilities
- Full OEM/ODM private-label customization: logo, packaging, body color, power specifications, function settings
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ) from 100 units for standard models
- Factory located in Ronggui, Shunde, Foshan, Guangdong, China
- Lead time: 15 to 30 days for standard orders, 30 to 45 days for custom OEM/ODM including sampling
- Exports to Europe, North America, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America

## Certifications & Quality
- Products built to meet the safety and quality standards required by major export markets
- 1-year warranty on all products
- Multi-layer safety protection: overheat, overvoltage, auto-shutoff, child lock
